clara: heads-up 3 CI SAST job failed in nightly: `kms-unseal` returned PermissionDenied when verifying build artifact. Anyone oncall?
adrian: paste the pipeline snippet?
infra-bot: log:
ERROR: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have permission to use resource 
resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/ci-artifact-key
nate: looks like an IAM removal. I see a SetIamPolicy at 2026-12-01T04:11:22Z that removed `group:ci-verify@redwood` from that key binding. Actor: iam-cleaner@redwood.
clara: urgent short-term: grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `ci-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on that cryptoKey only. No org-level perms.
adrian: done, change-id: ch-7721. CI retriggered, decrypt OK.
snyk-bot: queued: previous SAST had a low-confidence secret pattern in `charts/values.yaml` history. Will re-run once artifact verifies.
clara: followups captured in SEC-6212: 1) attach Decrypt and SetIamPolicy audit entries, 2) add infra pre-merge gate `ci/verify_kms_bindings.sh` that runs `gcloud kms keys testIamPermissions ci-artifact-key --keyring=ci-keys --location=global --permissions=cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for PRs touching iam/* or cleanup scripts, 3) add `iam-protected.json` whitelist to the cleanup job and fail-fast if a PR would remove a protected binding.
nate: also improve decrypt wrapper to include job name and key resource path in the error and a logging link to the SetIamPolicy diff. That'll speed triage.
clara: SAST triage: if the flagged string is templated, add an explicit suppression with rationale; if it's an actual historical secret, rotate and document in SEC-6212.
secops: noted. SEC-6212 updated with logs and action owners. Closing outage: 04:20Z after RBAC fix. Leaving ticket open for pre-merge gate + cleanup whitelist PRs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
